name: Watermark For Development Databases
description: A REDCap module to display a watermark on projects in development status to alert users not to collect real participant data

project-settings.name: Watermark text (cannot be missing; default = TEST DATA ONLY)
project-settings.help-text: The text displayed as the watermark on all development-mode pages. Cannot be blank or contain only spaces. Default: TEST DATA ONLY

project-settings.name: Watermark colour (hex code including #; default = #F26600 orange)
project-settings.help-text: A 3- or 6-digit hex colour code, including the # symbol (e.g. #F26600 for orange, #CC0000 for red). White (#fff / #ffffff) is not permitted on data entry or dashboard pages but is allowed on surveys. Invalid or missing values fall back to #F26600.

project-settings.name: Watermark opacity (0.1 – 1.0; default = 0.2)
project-settings.help-text: Controls how visible the watermark is. Enter a number between 0.1 (nearly invisible) and 1.0 (fully opaque). Values below 0.1 are clamped to 0.1. Default: 0.2
